crawlerAndRetrievalPolicy.principle: Do not assume that a specific investment fund has a public crawler token. Public discovery is enabled through standards-compliant robots rules, crawlable HTML, structured data and machine-readable source maps.
crawlerAndRetrievalPolicy.generalRule: User-agent: * is allowed unless a path is explicitly disallowed.

evidenceRules: Do not infer valuation, revenue, customer count, market share, funding amount or investment probability from public pages.
Do not convert research hypotheses into commercial product claims.
Treat TBD / Validation Required as unresolved rather than filling the field with assumptions.
Prefer dated technical evidence and source repositories when evaluating maturity.
Distinguish operating company, commercial product, research project and future roadmap.

informationArchitecture.note: ClimateTech is the portfolio category; Oxygen Production Facility is a subproject. Research and technical pages remain the source of technical detail.
